subject.title: fix: keep keyless web search on secrets fast path

question: Should the secrets runtime treat a matching plugin entry with `webSearch.omitAuth: true` as a generic, fail-closed proof that the selected web-search provider needs no in-container secret resolution?
rationale: The patch changes a security-adjacent startup eligibility boundary based on plugin-owned configuration semantics; tests cover the code path, but repository evidence supplied here does not establish a maintainer-approved generic plugin contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract after live proof
options.body: Keep the fail-closed exception, require redacted real startup proof for both the keyless and credential-bearing configurations, then merge if the runtime owner accepts the contract.

options.title: Keep the full resolver for plugin search
options.body: Reject the generic exemption and retain current resolver behavior until the plugin SDK exposes a more explicit capability contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed exception, require redacted real startup proof for both the keyless and credential-bearing configurations, then merge if the runtime owner accepts the contract.
